title: Aspiring writer-director here. I’ve got a question.

commenti.body: What the hell is going on with these posts? This must be the 1000st time some bot has asked the exact same thing from 100 different profiles. I can't even figure out what the reasoning behind it could be, it surely isn't karma farming. (If you wanted karma, just ask something vaguely sexual on AskReddit or repost someone's public meltdown for the millionth time.) It's a complete mystery. How about a noir dramedy about that? An obvious scam that never reveals its MO.
